$about: Every prototype in the playground. Status: draft · in-review · ready-for-dev. When a prototype is marked ready-for-dev, `npm run handoff` writes handoff/<id>.md for engineering.

prototypes.title: Fastpay dashboard · A · Overview
prototypes.author: Kapil
prototypes.idea: Faithful build of the Claude design prototype: status banner, migration progress, four balance KPIs, money saved, recent payments with payouts and disputes beside them.

prototypes.title: Fastpay dashboard · B · Money timeline
prototypes.author: Kapil
prototypes.idea: Answer 'when do I get my money?' first. The balance is a four-step flow from today's sales to the bank, and whatever blocks the flow is shown on the step it blocks.

prototypes.title: Fastpay dashboard · C · To-do first
prototypes.author: Kapil
prototypes.idea: Most visits come from an email. Lead with a short queue of things only the merchant can act on, sorted by deadline, with balance in a compact side summary.

prototypes.title: Fastpay payments, detail and refund
prototypes.author: Kapil
prototypes.idea: Filterable payments list, payment detail with fee and net breakdown and timeline, refund with the refund fee shown before confirming.
